howto.name: Upload an .odt file
howto.text: Drop an OpenDocument Text file (LibreOffice / OpenOffice) up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools renders via LibreOffice headless
howto.text: Fonts, styles, embedded images, tables, footnotes, and bibliography are preserved.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The output PDF matches the on-screen rendering closely.

faq.q: What about ODT-specific features (math equations, drawings)?
faq.a: OpenDocument math (Formula) and drawings render correctly as the LibreOffice converter handles them natively.

faq.q: Will fonts that aren't on the server cause problems?
faq.a: Missing fonts get substituted. Embedded fonts in the ODT are honored.
Macros are not executed — only the static document content is converted.
